description: Regex patterns for recurring security anti-patterns, grouped by language. Universal patterns run on all files; language-specific patterns run only when the file extension matches.

patterns.message: Unvalidated redirect target assigned to location.href. Ensure the variable is sanitized or use a safe routing method.
Non-timing-safe string comparison on a secret variable. Use crypto.timingSafeEqual instead.
Potentially unsafe input passed directly into an HTTP client. Validate and sanitize URL parameters first.
eval() on untrusted input enables arbitrary code execution. Use ast.literal_eval() for data parsing or eliminate eval entirely.
subprocess with shell=True is vulnerable to shell injection. Use shell=False with a list of arguments instead.
pickle.load/loads on untrusted data enables arbitrary code execution. Use a safe format (JSON, msgpack) or validate the source.
yaml.load without SafeLoader/FullLoader enables arbitrary code execution. Use yaml.safe_load() or specify Loader=yaml.SafeLoader.
SQL query built with fmt.Sprintf is vulnerable to SQL injection. Use parameterized queries with database/sql placeholders.
exec.Command with string concatenation is vulnerable to command injection. Use separate arguments instead of building a command string.
unsafe block detected. Document the safety invariant with a // SAFETY: comment explaining why this is sound.
Hardcoded AWS access key detected. Remove and inject via environment variable or secrets manager.
Private key material in source code. Remove immediately and load from a secure secrets store.
Possible hardcoded credential. Inject via environment variable or secrets manager instead.

Dockerfile.message: Missing USER instruction in Dockerfile. The container will run as root by default.
